newsitem.title: UK: Tile retailer Topps Tiles set for June 2 listing.
newsitem.headline: Tile retailer Topps Tiles set for June 2 listing.

text.p: UK specialist tile retailer Topps Tiles Plc said on Wednesday it had raised eight million stg via a placing and expected dealings in the shares to begin on the London Stock Exchange on June 2.
The company will have a market capitalisation of 20 million stg at the issue price of 100p per share.
Topps Tiles is one of the largest specialist tile retailers in England and Wales with 54 branches and said it planned to double the number of stores operated by the group over the next three years.

The company said in addition to establishing a share option scheme for senior employees, the two founder directors, chairman Stuart Williams and chief executive Barry Bester, have given 144,000 shares to an employee trust.
"The issue of shares enables a wider audience - including many of our own staff - to participate in what we believe will be a very exciting future," said Bester.

In the 53 weeks to June 1, 1996 Topps Tiles made a pre-tax profit of two million stg on sales of 22 million stg. Company directors forecasted profits for the year ending May 13 1997 would not be less than 2.45 million stg.

Topps Tiles said it aimed to become the leading retail brand in the UK tile market which market research for the industry estimates to be worth about 160 million stg and is forecast to grow by 21 per cent in the next four years.
